```python
artist_name = "Artist Name"
ranking = "most"  # or "least"

artists = apis.spotify.search_artists(query=artist_name)
artist_id = artists[0]["artist_id"]
sort_by = "-play_count" if ranking == "most" else "+play_count"
page = apis.spotify.search_songs(artist_id=artist_id, sort_by=sort_by)
song = page[0]
answer = song["title"]
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=answer, status="success")
```
